newsitem.title: USA: Alliance defaults on credit agreement.
newsitem.headline: Alliance defaults on credit agreement.

text.p: Alliance Entertainment Corp said Tuesday that it was in default under its credit agreement because it failed to make a required amortization payment of $2 million and had also failed to satisfy a financial covenant requiring it to raise $35 million of equity prior to July 1.

The company also said that in light of the default, it believed it highly unlikely that its banks would permit it to make an interest payment due July 15 on $125 million of 11.25 percent senior subordinated debentures.
Under the terms of its credit agreement, the company said its banks have the right to accelerate the maturity of about $190 million in outstanding debt.

While the company has not received a waiver from the banks with respect to its default, it is in discussions with its banks and does not believe that they intend to accelerate the outstanding indebtedness.
Alliance said it is considering all options, including one or a combination of certain financing proposals with third parties, but no assurance can be given that it will succeed.
